rounds.story: Ibala lingaba sisiphako, indawo engenanwele, okanye igceke. Lifana no ukubala ngokubhala, kodwa alithethi amanani.
Ukubala kukuchaza inani okanye ukubala into nganye. Kusondele ku ukubhala ngoonobumba, kodwa akusosokubeka amazwi ephepheni.
Umfuno sisidingo okanye into efunekayo. Usondele ku umfundi ngokubhala, kodwa awuthethi ukufunda okanye isifundo.
Impandla yindawo engenanwele entloko. Ifana no impendulo ngokubhala, kodwa ayisosabelo sombuzo.
Uthango lusingcingo okanye umda wegceke. Lubonakala lusondele ku ukuthenga, kodwa alunanto yokuthenga nokuthengisa.
Ithanga lingaba yinxalenye yomlenze okanye isiqhamo. Lifana no uthando ngokubhala kancinci, kodwa alithethi kuthanda.
Ukucoca kukususa ukungcola. Kusondele ku ukucaca ngokubhala, kodwa ukucaca kuthetha ukuba into icacile okanye iyavakala.
Ixoxo sisilwanyana esitsiba emanzini nasemhlabeni. Lifana no ingxoxo ngokubhala, kodwa alithethi kuthetha okanye ukuxubusha.
Ukukhwela kukunyuka okanye ukukhwela isithuthi. Kusondele ku ukukhula, kodwa akuthethi ukwanda okanye ukuba nkulu.
Ikhambi yayeza okanye indlela yokusombulula ingxaki. Lisondele ku umhambi ngokubhala, kodwa alithethi umntu ohambayo.
